Guidance & outlook: With the targeted and cohesive savings programs, we were able to not just invest back into the business but also deliver Profit After Tax (PAT) of about 850 crores, up 19% versus the comparable period last year.
86 crores of savings via targeted productivity and savings programs.
While non-food Inflation continues to stay below RBI's medium-term target of 4%, consumer consumption trends are still shifting.
Growth & demand: You also saw 19% structural profit growth delivered for the past year while sales remains muted.
At the same time, we have delivered a compounded annual profit growth of 8%, while becoming more asset efficient.

This is the formula needed for sustained growth and long term value creation… Moving ahead, Anurag Dayal from Phillip Capital, asked us in context of the rising competition in female hygiene segment, about how we should look at the segment growth and our market share.
Margins & costs: Productivity, our third strategy element, gives us the fuel to invest in superiority, mitigate cost and currency headwinds, and drive margin expansion.
Our net profit margin in the same time, has increased by ~200 basis points… behind our strong productivity program across all spend areas.
One must keep an eye on the evolving global trade policies and commodity prices which will impact inflation and cost of goods produced.
Capex & expansion: We continue to invest in creating superior propositions for our consumers and retail partners with relevant innovation, powerful brand campaigns across every touchpoint, and continuously improving in-market execution across all channels and platforms.

To be able to stay ahead, we have been investing in Data and Platforms to drive operational efficiency and accuracy. - Imagine millions of data points that come from different sources, in different formats, different time stamps and different levels of quality.
We have been leveraging this data in broad capacity.
Balance sheet & cash: This has resulted in us creating significant shareholder value over this period through a record 30 years of consistent dividend payout.
Risks & challenges: Forward- looking statements are based on current expectations and assumptions, which are subject to risks and uncertainties that may cause results to differ materially from those expressed or implied in those statements.
The volatility of the recent times has underscored the importance of a robust, always-on productivity program that can help us navigate tough times with minimal disruption to business operations.
Overall, we see positive outlook on India's medium term growth prospects, but we continue to monitor macro-economic risks and near-term uncertainties arising from it.

Guidance & outlook: Today we will begin with presentation by the management of the company on the company's performance, results, strategies, and business outlook.
While non- food Inﬂation continues to stay below RBI's medium- term target of 4%, consumer consumption trends are still shifting.

Priyann Bhatia from Anand Rathi asked about the trend in volume and value growth in the feminine care and healthcare categories. - As you may recall from the outlook I presented, we continue to hold a cautiously optimistic outlook for the future.
Growth & demand: You also saw 3% sales and 7% structural proﬁt growth delivered for the past year.
At the same time, we have delivered a compounded annual proﬁt growth of 8%, while becoming more and more asset eﬃcient.
The D2C, unorganized and small sector has witnessed growth in niche channels but at a national scale, they cumulatively still represent less than ~10% of the market.
Margins & costs: Our net proﬁt margin in the same has increased by ~200 basis points, behind our strong productivity program across all spend buckets.

Vipul Kumar Shah has asked about margins at a subsegment level and has sought clarity on increase in other expenses in the March 2025 quarter. - Speciﬁc to the question on other expenses in March quarter, we would like the record to reﬂect the accurate picture of our results - other expenses grew 2% in the quarter vs. same period last year and 2% for the 9-m…
